instruction: Adjust the system audio to a balanced medium volume level of 50%.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command:
pulseaudio --start
pactl list sinks | grep '^[[:space:]]Volume:' | head -n 1 | awk '{print $5}' | sed 's/%//g'

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to set system volume to 50%. Evaluator uses pactl command to check volume percentage, expecting '50\n' output. Uses existing exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter - no custom functions needed.
metadata.verification: Verified that pactl command returns volume percentage as integer (0-100) followed by newline. Volume 50% produces output '50\n'.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks the single requirement: system volume at 50%
Getter extracts current volume level via pactl command which has been verified to work
Metric uses exact_match which is appropriate for checking specific volume percentage
Expected value '50\n' is semantically correct for 50% volume level
Command logic properly extracts volume percentage by starting PulseAudio, listing sinks, and parsing output
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider edge case: If system has multiple audio sinks, command only checks first sink (head -n 1). Agent might adjust a different sink than what's being verified.
Consider adding error handling or fallback if PulseAudio is not available, though current behavior (returning None -> score 0.0) is acceptable
